about: Read notes.md and tell me the release day. Don't run commands. / Without reading anything again, which day was it? Two turns from another client of the harness, whose record of the session is read while the session is still open there.

known.line: user: Read notes.md and tell me the release day. Don't run commands.
known.reason: Devin.app's journal holds only the session updates Devin sends (`handleClientRequest` -> `_ingestSessionUpdate`); the prompt row the app draws is its own optimistic `user_message_chunk`, never stored. Devin 3000.10.23 sends no prompt back, even with Devin.app's `cognition.ai/messageGrouping` and a `cognition.ai/clientMessageId` on each prompt, so until the app reopens the session its journal has no prompts. Devin's CLI store keeps them, and the catalog shows that record where both hold the session (`clientCopy`).
